name: House of Doge Inc. Common Stock
summary: Brag House Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of an electronic video game sports (eSports) platform. It is also involved in marketing and recruiting, networks, events and production, and partnerships and sponsorships among eSports casual college gamers and fans. The company was founded by Lavell Juan Malloy II and Daniel Leibovich on February 23, 2018 and is headquartered in Montclair, NJ.
